components.name: Straight wing stair landing pair
components.function: Missing connections between original stepped wings/roof courts; do not change front fountain/stair layout
components.construction: One isolated straight wing stair landing pair with ivory/rose steps, true flight/landing depth, simple source gold edge profiles, parapet decor removable. Equal proposed risers, clear passage and underside, planar joining faces. No cascade or new main entrance layout.
components.attachment_face: Underside/root to ground or declared host; keep true openings clear
components.semantic_front: Main visible face +Y and Zup; sides are actual thickness, not flattened painting
components.design_basis: Visible source vocabulary with missing construction views or new habitat forms; metrics and hidden surfaces proposed
